title: THE PLACE AND CONNECTIONS OF UZBEK AND KOREAN LANGUAGES IN THE CONTEXT OF THE ALTAIC LANGUAGE FAMILY: A TYPOLOGICAL AND HISTORICAL PERSPECTIVE
description: This article analyzes the genetic and typological proximity of the Uzbek and Korean languages within the framework of the Altaic language family. Through a comparative-historical method, the commonalities of agglutinative structure, word order (SOV), and morphological indicators are explored. The article serves to reveal the historical roots of the structural similarities between the two languages.
